children: Pranav Mukul & Mohit Bhalla New Delhi: Subscription-based furniture company Furlenco is planning a potential 1,000-1,200 crore initial public offering (IPO), people in the know said. The company is seeking a valuation of around 7,000 crore, one of the persons said, adding that the final valuation will be decided closer to the IPO, "depending on market conditions and the response during investor roadshows." The IPO is expected to be launched in the next fiscal year. "The issue will comprise a primary capital raise and may also see an offer-for-sale by existing backers," the person said.

Its rival Rentomojo earlier this month saw its IPO subscribed 73 times, followed by a strong listing on September 17. Furlenco is backed by listed company Sheela Foam, the owner of Kurlon and Sleepwell mattresses. The Bengaluru-based company is working with merchant bankers on the proposed issue and is expected to soon finalise ICICI Securities as an advisor, people cited above said.

It reported 370 crore in revenue from operations in fiscal 2026, up 62% year-on-year. Its net profit jumped 19-fold to 59.5 crore during the year, while earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation (Ebitda) nearly doubled to 129.5 crore, translating into an Ebitda margin of 35%. Furlenco last raised 125 crore in fresh funding from Sheela Foam, WhiteOak and stock market investor Madhusudan Kela in December 2025.

Sheela Foam had first invested in Furlenco in 2023, putting 300 crore into the company for a 35% stake. Founded in 2012, Furlenco has also previously raised capital from venture capital firm Lightbox and Zinnia Global Fund. Queries sent to Furlenco, Sheela Foam and ICICI Securities did not elicit a response at the time of publishing.

title: Furniture Rental Co Furlenco Gears Up for 1.2k-crore IPO
